entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What's wrong? You seem out of it.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Huh? Is that some kind of joke?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: This whole get-together was your idea...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Y'know, something hit me a while back—[n]we're the same age. You don't have[n]to be so polite to me.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But Futaba-senpai, I still think of you[n]that way.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Then as your senpai, I order you to speak[n]casually to me! And no "-senpai"!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's no biggie, just go with whatever's[n]easier for ya. Your senpai allows it!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Attention, everybody: it's ehomaki time![n]I'm gonna do my thing!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Just gotta make a wish, and then eat[n]this whole thing in one shot!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So... What direction am I supposed[n]to face for this to be good luck?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It says that's north-northwest of here,[n]and a bit to the right, so...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't say a word to me until I'm done,[n]got it? I gotta eat the whole thing without[n]talkin' for the wish to come true.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do we actually have to watch this?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'd be hard-pressed to call this[n]picturesque.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Do you really think eating an entire[n]roll of sushi could grant your wish?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I prefer throwing beans for luck.[n]Drive them demons away!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sojiro, you be the demon this year.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And are you going to be the one[n]who cleans up afterwards?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Come on, Ryuji-senpai! You can do it!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But I really do appreciate all of my[n]senpai cheering me on!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's right we're cheering you on![n]We've got your back, no matter what.[n]After all, this is where you belong!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah! We'll always be together.[n]And that goes for all of you!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Fine, fine! I'll just try again!
We were in a very complicated[n]situation, and I'm not certain, but...[n]maybe this is all for the best...
